segments.text: Smart glasses show live subtitles for deaf users. Also coming up: Tech giants agree on a common charger standard for laptops. And later, our number of the day. This is TECH BYTES. I'm Max Circuit, with Ada Volt.
“We want everyone to follow the conversation,” a spokesperson said. A company in Berlin has shown smart glasses that display live subtitles of conversations, Circuit Weekly reports.
segments.headline: Smart glasses show live subtitles for deaf users

quote.text: We want everyone to follow the conversation

segments.text: Several large technology companies have agreed on a common charging standard for laptops. Chargers will work across brands from next year, according to Circuit Weekly.
segments.headline: Tech giants agree on a common charger standard for laptops

segments.text: Thanks, Ada. Our number of the day: 3 percent. Measurements show a large glacier in the Alps lost 3 percent of its volume this summer, Starfield Journal reports. Scientists say the ice is now thinner than at any time since records began.
segments.headline: Glacier in the Alps shrinks by 3 percent in one summer

segments.text: And finally: A comet discovered last year will pass close to Earth this week and should be visible with binoculars just after sunset.
segments.headline: Comet will pass close enough to see with binoculars this week

segments.text: I have questions. Most of them start with how.
That's TECH BYTES. From Ada Volt and from me, thanks for watching. More news around the clock on GLOBIT 24.
